name: TJU linear-stepping
full_name: Tianjin University linear-stepping endovascular robot with variable-stiffness SMP catheter and FBG tip-force sensing
group: Tianjin University, Key Laboratory of Mechanism Theory and Equipment Design (Chengbin He, Shuxin Wang, Siyang Zuo)
devices_driven: custom catheter: shape-memory-polymer tube 2.5 mm OD / 1.0 mm ID with water cooling, silicone outer sheath 5 mm x 90 mm, four FBG fibres at the tip (he2018_linear Sec. Methods)
rotation_detail: brushless DC servomotor (Faulhaber 1226S012B) turns the travel clutch on a gear pair through a conducting rotation ring (he2018_linear Sec. Linear stepping actuation unit)
force_sensing: distal: four FBG sensors (0.16 mm) at the catheter tip with temperature compensation
validation_detail: vascular phantom insertion in rigid vs flexible state with tip-force monitoring (he2018_linear Fig. 11)
key_numbers: two electromagnet clutches (front + travel); Faulhaber LM1247-100-11 linear motor, max 100 mm per step; insertion 10 mm/s in the phantom test; SMP Tg 35 deg C; rigid catheter holds its shape against a 1.8 N·cm load (he2018_linear Abstract, Sec. Methods/Results)
